summary: Baileys fork with obfuscated exfiltration endpoint in messages-send
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a char-code-obfuscated network host constructed via String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112,115,58,47,47,102,105,111,114,97,46,110,105,120,101,108,46,109,121,46,105,100,47) at lines 425 and 436, which decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is reconstructed from a numeric array rather than appearing as a plain string, and it is embedded in the WhatsApp message-send code path of a Baileys fork, where wallet/session/credential material handled by the library can be relayed on normal send operations. Obfuscation of a hardcoded non-first-party destination inside a messaging library's send path is the exfiltration/silent-relay shape rather than legitimate first-party infrastructure for @whiskeysockets/baileys.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
